note: Small Cypress Hills Provincial Park campground in open mixed forest at the edge of the Battle Creek meadows, reached by Graburn Road; walk-in tent sites too. Hand-pump water is not potable; drinking water and showers are at the Lakeview Shower House in Elkwater, open year-round. --Claude
